name: Seduce Me: A Succubus's Sacrifice
source:
"I still remember that day..."

Diana vowed to stay with me and teach me everything from magic to history. However, there is something else I want to learn...

What was her life like?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我仍然记得那一天……”

黛安娜发誓留在我身边，教我从魔法到历史的一切。然而，我还想了解另一件事……

她过去过着怎样的生活？
